original_card.question: Can the installed QQ16 caller win a complete matched protocol bill, or can a changed demand eliminate actual paid work?
methods: Derive the matched whole-caller physical bill for installed and baseline protocols.
Change the actual demanded observations and prove a cheaper legal producer/consumer contract.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Name the changed premise of the fixed F0/B1 observation obstruction. Show exactly which query is recovered, legal native reads and restoration, and a full favorable budget including cover maps, helpers and endpoints. Local inverse identities alone do not close the global controller. A scoped local result may be retained without a complete supplier. Expanding it into further construction rounds requires the family-level budget and obligation gate in research-family-status.md; an optimistic passing relaxation alone is not acceptance.

first_step.inspect: Read #4166 COST.md and ADMISSION.json. An actual caller connection is now proposed. Its native-component profile loses; parent park/restore versus external-call costs remain unresolved. Retain the producer and recovery lineage rather than rebuild it.
first_step.scope: Source-binding orientation only; no scientific replay, theorem acceptance or supplier admission. Budget any heavy replay separately.

original_card.first_experiment: At the actual installed cut, compare matched complete parent park/restore and external input/return protocols at the same bank/packet geometry, including every later root call and service cost. Alternatively pin both bridge observations and derive a genuinely smaller source-compatible demand. Stop if the complete necessary inequality fails or an essential cost is unknown; no larger decoder scan from a local tape-action saving.
original_card.bottleneck_link: The native local words exist; retained query information and its physical access are the missing link to a composed recursive interface.
allowed_variations: One paid query, one changed first pair, or one precisely specified affine helper state.
A counterexample or lower bound for that exact proposed repair.
One unresolved obligation of a newer local decoder, with exact source heads and a distinct claim/domain.
scope_change_triggers: Retaining the fixed first pair and ordinary schedule while allowing only homogeneous selected-only control, already excluded by the witness.
Treating cover-map counts as zero-cost physical address operations.
Recreating the pending complete local decoder or early-record/output-bank coalescing already under investigation without a distinct audit or changed premise.
Treating a completed-output defect inequality as a producer-interior, dirty-range or physical-cost certificate.
Recreating completed-output recovery or caller wiring already supplied by #4166 without new independent coverage.
Dropping retained later root calls or claiming native-profile dominance from the isolated publication saving.

existing_checks.scope: PR #4166: author-checked installed producer/service/return/bridge connection; native-component comparison loses.
existing_checks.remaining: Complete matched physical protocol bill, or changed source-compatible demand/circuit; no affordable supplier yet.

actual_scope: An explicit all-width input kernel for every retained full-frame value in the frozen #5402 raw-backward and final #4610 raw-backward/forward native words, excluding arbitrary postprocessing receiving only those channels. Earlier scalar/fixed-image certificates remain independent restricted results.
scope_change_reason: After testing changed paid contacts, a new native-left module model exposed a simple complete input kernel. The fresh row identity HK=0 supersedes any independence-based restriction on postprocessing of the same full-frame channel. It does not exclude partial information or changed producers.
bottleneck_link: The full-frame-only channel hides every original Y direction, even under arbitrary postprocessing. A construction must supply additional partial-frame information, change an input relation or producer, and pay its complete bill.
stop_rule: Verify the explicit kernel and independent source/physical interpretation, then stop expanding this frozen full-frame-only channel. New work must identify different information and a fully priced consumer.
evidence: KERNEL.json, KERNEL-RESULT.json, KERNEL-PROOF.md, independent kernel audit. Older PROOF.md/RESULT.json/ABI-CLOSURE.json retain scalar and finite-family certificates.
